title: 第019章 点破丹田废城主第020章 清雪毁容赎罪孽
lines: 午后的阳光，将秦夜的影子在空旷的长街上拉得很长。他从城主府出来，并没有立刻前往城西的秦家，而是身形一转，朝着城墙西南角的方向走去——他需要先回一趟山林木屋，确认阿萝的安全，并将城主府的结果告诉她。
穿过几条依旧死寂的街巷，避开零星的、看到他如同见鬼般躲开的行人，秦夜再次从排水涵洞潜出城外。一出城，他便施展身法，朝着山林方向疾掠。真气在贯通的手太阴肺经中流畅运行，虽然只是淬体一重巅峰，但配合他精妙的身法和对力量的掌控，速度竟不比寻常淬体三四重的武者慢。
不到半个时辰，他便回到了那片熟悉的山林。远远地，他便看到了木屋。木屋很安静，没有打斗或破坏的痕迹，周围他布下的预警机关也完好无损。他心中微定，加快了脚步。
推开木屋虚掩的门，光线涌入。阿萝正坐在干草铺上，双手抱着膝盖，眼神紧张地望着门口，手里还紧紧攥着秦夜给她的、削尖的木棍。当看清进来的是秦夜时，她眼中的紧张瞬间化为惊喜，随即又涌上浓浓的担忧。
“秦大哥！”阿萝挣扎着想站起来，但伤腿还不能受力，只能急切地问，“你回来了！你没事吧？城里……怎么样了？我听到好多声音，好像很乱……”
她一口气问了许多，眼睛在秦夜身上快速扫过，看到他衣衫上沾染的、已经干涸发黑的血迹，脸色更是白了白。
“我没事，一点皮外伤。”秦夜走到水缸旁，舀了瓢水，简单清洗了一下脸上和手上的血污，又换了身干净的备用衣服。“城里的麻烦，暂时解决了大半。”
“解决了？”阿萝愣了一下，没太明白“解决了大半”是什么意思。城主府和秦家那样的庞然大物，怎么可能轻易“解决”？
秦夜在她旁边坐下，从怀中取出几个还温热的包子——是他在回程路上，从一个匆匆收摊的早点铺“买”的。“边吃边说。”
他将包子递给阿萝，自己也拿起一个，慢慢吃着，同时用尽可能简洁平静的语气，将今日在城主府门前发生的一切，以及进入府内后与苏远山、苏清雪、紫阳卫的对峙，还有他提出的三个条件和最后的结果，大致讲述了一遍。
他没有渲染过程如何惊险，也没有描述细节如何血腥，只是平铺直叙。但即便如此，阿萝依旧听得小嘴微张，眼睛瞪得溜圆，连手里的包子都忘了吃。
独自一人，走向戒备森严的城主府……
箭雨临身，空手拨箭，甚至反弹伤人……
一拳轰杀淬体三重护卫，三招重创淬体五重统领赵刚……
紫阳卫至，令牌一出，四方惊退……
逼迫苏清雪毁容守墓，要求苏远山自废修为、散尽家财……
每一件事，都如同惊雷，在她脑海中炸响。她虽然年纪小，见识不多，但也清楚这意味着什么。这意味着，那个高高在上、如同山岳般压在她和无数贫苦百姓头上的苏家，那个害死她爹娘、打断她腿的仇人，被秦大哥……生生打垮了！
“秦大哥……你……”阿萝声音哽咽，眼泪毫无征兆地涌了出来，大颗大颗地滚落，混合着包子的碎屑，“谢谢你……真的谢谢你……我爹娘……他们在天有灵，一定……一定会瞑目的……”
她哭得说不出完整的话，只是不停地重复着“谢谢”，瘦弱的肩膀因为激动和释放而剧烈耸动。这些日子以来，支撑她活下去的，除了秦夜的救治和希望，便是那刻骨的仇恨。如今，仇人即将得到惩罚，虽然不是手刃，但这种公道的讨还，更让她感到一种难以言喻的解脱和……快意。
秦夜默默地看着她哭，没有安慰。有些情绪，需要宣泄。他只是将水囊递过去。
阿萝哭了好一会儿，才渐渐平息下来，用袖子胡乱擦了擦脸，眼睛红肿，但眼神却比以往任何时候都更加明亮有神，那是一种卸下了沉重枷锁、看到了希望的光芒。
“秦大哥，那……那你现在要去秦家吗？”阿萝问，眼中又露出一丝担忧。秦家虽然不如城主府势大，但毕竟是秦夜的本家，其中关系错综复杂。
“嗯，要去。”秦夜点头，“不过，在去秦家之前，我们需要先回一趟城里。”
“回城里？”阿萝不解。
“去你爹娘坟前。”秦夜看着她，缓缓道，“苏清雪要去那里守墓，我要先带你去，让你亲眼看到，也要……让你爹娘看看。”
阿萝浑身一震，刚刚止住的泪水又有决堤的趋势。她用力点头，声音带着哭腔和坚定：“嗯！我去！我要去告诉爹娘，害他们的人，得到报应了！”
“不过，在这之前，”秦夜话锋一转，眉头微蹙，“苏远山那边，我给了他三天时间。但现在想想，三天，变数太多。尤其是他一旦缓过劲来，或者暗中搞什么小动作，虽然我不惧，但终究麻烦。而且，紫阳宗使者虽走，但难保不会再有其他人介入。”
他看着阿萝：“你的仇，苏清雪守墓只是其一。苏远山这个纵容女儿、昏聩暴虐的城主，才是罪魁祸首。他自废修为的承诺，不能完全指望他自己。我需要……亲自去确保，这件事，立刻落实。”
阿萝明白了秦夜的意思，心脏猛地一跳：“秦大哥，你是要……现在就去废了他？”
“他必须为自己所做的一切，付出最直接的代价。”秦夜眼神冰冷，“修为，是他作威作福的依仗。废了他的修为，比杀了他，更能让他体会失去一切的痛苦，也更能震慑那些心怀叵测之人。而且，只有这样，他才会真正害怕，才会老老实实去散尽家财，去公告罪状。”
他站起身：“你在这里等我，我再去一趟城主府，了结此事，然后回来接你进城。”
“秦大哥，我跟你一起去！”阿萝急道，挣扎着想站起来。
“你腿伤未愈，不能乱动。”秦夜按住她，“放心，很快。城主府现在，没人能拦我。”
他的语气充满自信。事实也的确如此，经此一役，城主府的护卫力量已被彻底打垮，赵刚重伤，苏远山昏迷，苏清雪崩溃，紫阳宗退走，整个城主府上下，已无一人有胆气、有能力阻挡他。
阿萝看着秦夜不容置疑的眼神，知道再坚持也无用，只能担忧地点点头：“那你一定要小心……早点回来。”
“嗯。”秦夜应了一声，没有再多说，转身再次出了木屋，身形如电，重新没入山林，朝着青云城方向而去。
这一次，他目标明确，行动更加迅捷。不过两刻钟，他便再次潜回城内，来到了依旧死寂、但空气中弥漫着未散血腥味的城主府前。
府门依旧洞开着，无人把守。前院的尸体和伤员似乎已经被简单清理过，但地上的血迹和狼藉依旧触目惊心。秦夜迈步而入，没有遇到任何阻拦，沿途遇到的少数仆役，看到他如同看到瘟神，远远就跪伏在地，瑟瑟发抖。
他径直走向苏远山的寝殿。
寝殿内，程济世还在为苏远山施针，试图稳住他紊乱的气血。苏清雪瘫坐在床边的地上，眼神空洞，仿佛失去了灵魂。两个幕僚则垂手站在远处，面如死灰。看到秦夜去而复返，程济世施针的手一颤，苏清雪空洞的眼神骤然聚焦，化为惊恐，两个幕僚更是吓得腿一软，差点跪倒。
“秦……秦公子，您……您怎么又回来了？”程济世强作镇定，声音干涩。
content_en:
The afternoon sun stretched Qin Ye's shadow long on the empty long street. When he came out of the City Lord's Mansion, he did not immediately go to the Qin family in the west of the city. Instead, he turned around and walked towards the southwest corner of the city wall - he needed to go back to the mountain cabin first to confirm A Luo's safety and tell her the results of the City Lord's Mansion.
After passing through several still dead streets and avoiding the scattered pedestrians who shunned him as if they were seeing ghosts, Qin Ye once again sneaked out of the city through the drainage culvert. As soon as he left the city, he used his body skills to rush toward the mountains and forests. The true energy flows smoothly through the hand-taiyin lung meridian. Although he is only at the peak of the first level of Body Tempering, with his exquisite body skills and control of power, his speed is no slower than that of ordinary warriors at the third or fourth level of Body Tempering.
In less than half an hour, he returned to the familiar forest. In the distance, he saw the wooden house. The wooden house was quiet, with no signs of fighting or destruction, and the early warning systems he had set up around it were also intact. He calmed down slightly and quickened his pace.
Pushing open the ajar door of the wooden house, light floods in. A'Luo was sitting on the hay bunk, holding her knees with both hands, looking nervously at the door, still holding tightly the sharpened stick that Qin Ye gave her. When she saw that it was Qin Ye who came in, the tension in her eyes instantly turned into surprise, and then she was filled with deep worry.
"Brother Qin!" A'luo struggled to stand up, but her injured leg couldn't bear the force, so she could only ask eagerly, "You're back! Are you okay? How is... the city? I heard a lot of noises, it seems to be very chaotic..."
She asked a lot of questions in one breath, her eyes quickly swept over Qin Ye's body, and her face turned even paler when she saw the dried and blackened blood on his clothes.
"I'm fine, just a little skin injury." Qin Ye walked to the water tank, took a scoop of water, briefly washed the blood on his face and hands, and changed into clean spare clothes. "Most of the troubles in the city have been solved for the time being."
"Resolved?" A Luo was stunned for a moment, not quite understanding what "mostly resolved" meant. How could behemoths like the City Lord's Mansion and the Qin Family be easily "solved"?
Qin Ye sat down next to her and took out a few warm buns from his arms - he "bought" them from a breakfast shop that had hurriedly closed its stall on the way back. "Talking while eating."
He handed the bun to A Luo, picked up one himself, and ate it slowly. At the same time, in as concise and calm a tone as possible, he roughly recounted everything that happened in front of the city lord's mansion today, as well as the confrontation with Su Yuanshan, Su Qingxue, and Ziyang Wei after entering the mansion, as well as the three conditions he proposed and the final result.
He did not describe how thrilling the rendering process was, nor how bloody the details were, but simply described it in a straightforward manner. But even so, Ah Luo's mouth still opened slightly, her eyes widened, and she even forgot to eat the bun in her hand.
Alone, walking towards the heavily guarded City Lord's Mansion...
A rain of arrows is coming, and if you pick the arrows with your bare hands, they may even bounce back and hurt someone...
One punch killed the body-tempered third-level guard, and three moves severely damaged Zhao Gang, the fifth-level body-tempering commander...
The Ziyang Guard arrived, and as soon as the token was issued, all parties retreated...
Forcing Su Qingxue to disfigure her face and guard the tomb, asking Su Yuanshan to abandon his cultivation and dissipate his family wealth...
Everything was like thunder, exploding in her mind. Although she was young and didn't have much experience, she knew what it meant. This meant that the Su family, which was so high above her and weighed down like a mountain on her and countless poor people, the enemy who killed her parents and broke her legs, was defeated by Brother Qin...
"Brother Qin...you..." Ah Luo's voice was choked, and tears welled up without warning, and rolled down in large pieces, mixed with the crumbs of the buns, "Thank you...I really thank you...my parents...they have souls in heaven, and they will definitely...will rest in peace..."
She cried so much that she couldn't speak complete words, she just kept repeating "thank you", her thin shoulders shaking violently with excitement and release. In these days, what kept her alive, apart from Qin Ye's treatment and hope, was her deep-seated hatred. Now, her enemy was about to be punished. Although it was not with a sword, this kind of fair retribution made her feel an indescribable relief and... pleasure.
Qin Ye watched her cry silently without comforting her. Some emotions need to be vented. He just handed over the water bag.
A Luo cried for a while and then gradually calmed down. She wiped her face carelessly with her sleeves. Her eyes were red and swollen, but her eyes were brighter and more energetic than ever before. It was a light that had removed heavy shackles and seen hope.
"Brother Qin, then... are you going to the Qin family now?" A Luo asked, with a trace of worry in her eyes. Although the Qin family is not as powerful as the city lord's palace, it is Qin Ye's family after all, and the relationship between them is complicated.
"Yes, we have to go." Qin Ye nodded, "But before going to Qin's house, we need to go back to the city first."
"Back to the city?" A Luo was puzzled.
"Go to your parents' grave." Qin Ye looked at her and said slowly, "Su Qingxue is going there to guard the grave. I want to take you there first so that you can see it with your own eyes, and also... let your parents see it."
A Luo was shocked, and the tears that had just stopped were threatening to burst again. She nodded vigorously, her voice filled with tears and determination: "Yes! I'm going! I'm going to tell my parents that the person who harmed them has been punished!"
"But before that," Qin Ye changed the topic and frowned slightly, "I gave Su Yuanshan three days. But now that I think about it, there are too many variables in three days. Especially if he calms down or does something secretly, although I am not afraid, it will be troublesome after all. Moreover, although the Ziyang Sect envoy has left, there is no guarantee that others will not intervene."
He looked at A Luo: "Su Qingxue's tomb-keeping is just one of your grievances. Su Yuanshan, the city lord who indulged his daughter and was ignorant and violent, is the culprit. His promise to abolish his cultivation cannot be fully counted on himself. I need to... personally ensure that this matter is implemented immediately."
Ah Luo understood what Qin Ye meant, and her heart skipped a beat: "Brother Qin, are you going to...kill him now?"
"He must pay the most direct price for everything he has done." Qin Ye's eyes were cold. "Cultivation is what he relies on to dominate. Destroying his cultivation will make him feel the pain of losing everything more than killing him, and it will also deter those who have ulterior motives. Moreover, only in this way will he be truly afraid, and will he honestly spend all his wealth and publicize his crimes."
He stood up and said, "Wait for me here. I'll go to the city lord's mansion again to settle the matter, and then come back to take you into the city."
"Brother Qin, I'll go with you!" Ah Luo said anxiously, struggling to stand up.
"Your leg is still injured, so you can't move around." Qin Ye held her down, "Don't worry, it will be quick. No one can stop me now in the City Lord's Mansion."
His tone was confident. This is indeed the case. After this battle, the guard force of the City Lord's Mansion has been completely defeated. Zhao Gang was seriously injured, Su Yuanshan was unconscious, Su Qingxue collapsed, and the Ziyang Sect retreated. No one in the entire City Lord's Mansion had the courage or ability to stop him.
A'luo looked at Qin Ye's unquestionable eyes and knew that it was useless to persist. She could only nodded worriedly: "Then you must be careful... come back early."
"Yes." Qin Ye responded without saying anything more. He turned around and left the wooden house again. His body was like lightning, and he disappeared into the forest again, heading towards Qingyun City.
This time, his goals were clear and his actions were quicker. Within two-quarters of an hour, he sneaked back into the city again and arrived in front of the city lord's palace, which was still deathly silent, but the smell of undisturbed blood filled the air.
The door of the mansion was still open and unguarded. The corpses and wounded in the front yard seemed to have been simply cleaned up, but the blood stains and mess on the ground were still shocking. Qin Ye stepped in without encountering any obstacles. The few servants he met along the way felt like they were seeing the god of plague, and they knelt on the ground from a distance, trembling.
He walked straight to Su Yuanshan's bedroom.
In the dormitory, Cheng Jishi was still applying acupuncture on Su Yuanshan, trying to stabilize his disordered energy and blood. Su Qingxue sat slumped on the ground beside the bed, her eyes empty, as if she had lost her soul. The two staff members stood in the distance with their hands hanging, their faces ashen. Seeing Qin Ye go and come back, Cheng Jishi's acupuncture hand trembled. Su Qingxue's empty eyes suddenly focused and turned into panic. The two staff members were so frightened that their legs weakened and they almost fell to their knees.
"Qin... Mr. Qin, you... why are you back again?" Cheng Jishi tried to calm down, his voice dry.
title_en: Chapter 019: Defeat the ruined city lord in Dantian Chapter 020: Qingxue’s disfigurement to atone for sins
